payload.reasoning_summary: FASE-1 is the earliest incomplete phase. Nominal economic types and fixed scales are binding ADR-003 primitives, require no unresolved DEFINIR decision, and are the smallest complete dependency needed by both domain and world work. RNG and rounding work require ADR decisions first; ledger and price generation still depend on missing core primitives.
risks: An overly permissive brand declaration could allow structural or cross-brand assignment; compile-time negative fixtures must detect this.
Runtime callers can bypass TypeScript types, so constructors or guards must validate unknown inputs without coercion.
Changing the core export surface can accidentally regress CanonicalEncoder exports.

acceptance_criteria: packages/core/src/index.mts exports branded TypeScript types Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, and Tick.

packages/core/src/index.mts exports QUANTITY_SCALE as 100_000_000n, PRICE_SCALE as 10_000n, and RATE_SCALE as 100_000_000n, with bigint literal types preserved where supported by the existing public API conventions.
At runtime, each Money, Quantity, Price, and Rate constructor or guard rejects non-bigint inputs and accepts bigint inputs without precision conversion.

At runtime, the Tick constructor or guard accepts 0 and Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and rejects negative values, values above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, non-integers, NaN, infinities, and non-number inputs.

Compile-time fixtures demonstrate that raw primitive values and values of a different brand cannot be assigned to any branded type without passing through its corresponding public constructor or guard.
No packages/core import is introduced, and the repository boundary checker remains green.
The full existing test suite, strict TypeScript build or typecheck, lint suite, and determinism-lint fixture suite remain green.
must_preserve: ADR-003 prohibition on floating-point representation for Money, Quantity, Price, and Rate.
INV-23: every Tick remains within the safe non-negative integer range.
Existing strict compiler, lint, boundary, and CI gates.
task.objective: Implement and export the ADR-003 nominal types, scale constants, and runtime-validated constructors required for FASE-1 domain and world development.
out_of_scope: Division and rounding helpers or ADR-004.
Ledger, world-price, application, contracts, UI, Electron, packaging, or replay implementation.
Arithmetic semantics beyond the specified scale constants and input validation.
Changes to CICLO_SPEC.md or unrelated repository infrastructure.
required_tests: Unit tests for valid and invalid runtime construction of all five nominal types.
Tick boundary tests at 0, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, -1, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1, fractional values, NaN, positive and negative infinity, bigint, string, null, and undefined.
Compile-time negative tests for cross-brand assignment and direct primitive assignment, plus positive tests for values returned by each constructor or guard.
Exact-value and bigint-type tests for all three scale constants.
Run the repository's full test, strict typecheck/build, lint, determinism-lint fixture, and package-boundary validation commands.
scope: Define branded Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, and Tick types in packages/core.
Export QUANTITY_SCALE = 100_000_000n, PRICE_SCALE = 10_000n, and RATE_SCALE = 100_000_000n as bigint constants.
Provide public constructors or guards that accept bigint for Money, Quantity, Price, and Rate and reject every non-bigint runtime value.
Provide a Tick constructor or guard that accepts only integer numbers in the inclusive range 0 through Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.
Export the types, constants, and constructors or guards from packages/core/src/index.mts.
Add runtime and compile-time tests for validation and nominal-brand isolation.
